Legal
Privacy Policy
Last updated 17 April 2025
Information We Collect
When you create an account or use MarkBot, we collect:
Account data — your name and email address.
Uploaded content — exam papers and any marking rubrics you provide.
Payment data — billing details, processed securely by Stripe. We never store card numbers.
Usage data — pages marked, credit balance, session logs.
How We Use It
We use your information only to operate and improve the service:
Process your exam papers through AI and return results.
Manage your account, credits, and payment history.
Send transactional emails (marking complete, low credits, etc.).
Diagnose technical issues and improve accuracy.
We do not sell your data. We do not use your papers to train models.
Data Storage & Security
Uploaded exam papers are stored in Supabase (EU region) and are tied to your account. You can delete them at any
time. Marking results are retained until you delete them or close your account.
All data in transit is encrypted with TLS. Stored files are encrypted at rest. Access is restricted by row-level security —
only you can read your papers.
Third-Party Services
We share data with the following processors, and only to the extent needed:
Google Gemini — receives paper images/text to perform marking. Google's enterprise API terms prohibit training on
submitted data.
Stripe — handles payment processing. We pass your billing info; we never store it ourselves.
Supabase — provides database and file storage. Data is hosted in the EU.
Your Rights
You can, at any time:
Export all your data from your account settings.
Delete individual papers or full marking batches.
Close your account and have all data permanently erased.
Contact us to correct any inaccurate personal information.

Cookies
We use a single session cookie to keep you logged in. We do not use advertising cookies or tracking pixels. No
third-party analytics scripts are loaded.
Contact
Questions or requests? Email us at privacy@markbot.org. We aim to respond within 2 business days.

Legal
Terms of Service
Last updated 17 April 2025
Acceptance of Terms
By creating an account or using MarkBot you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the
service.
What MarkBot Does
MarkBot uses AI (Google Gemini) to analyse and grade student exam papers against provided or inferred marking
criteria. Results are returned to the teacher who submitted the papers.
MarkBot is a tool to assist teachers — not a replacement for professional judgement. Final grading decisions remain with
the teacher.
Your Responsibilities
By using MarkBot you agree to:
Provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure.
Only upload content you have the right to process (e.g. papers from your own classes).
Not use the service for any unlawful purpose.
Review AI-generated marks before sharing results with students.
Comply with any data protection obligations applicable to you (e.g. GDPR, UK GDPR).
Credits & Payment
MarkBot operates on a prepaid credit system:
1 credit = 1 page of marking.
Credits are deducted when a batch is submitted. If a batch fails, credits are automatically refunded.
Credits do not expire.
All purchases are final. Credits cannot be exchanged for cash.
Payments are processed by Stripe. Your card details are handled by Stripe and never stored by us.
AI Limitations & Accuracy
AI marking is not perfect. Factors like poor scan quality, ambiguous handwriting, or unusual question formats can affect
accuracy.
Always review AI output before returning results to students.
Do not rely solely on MarkBot for high-stakes or formal assessments.
MarkBot is not liable for marks that are later found to be incorrect.

Intellectual Property
You retain full ownership of all content you upload. By using the service you grant MarkBot a limited, non-exclusive
licence to process that content for the sole purpose of delivering the marking service. We do not use your papers to train
AI models.
Limitation of Liability
MarkBot is provided “as is” without warranties of any kind, express or implied.
To the maximum extent permitted by law, MarkBot and its creator are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or
consequential damages arising from use of the service — including but not limited to incorrect grades, service downtime,
or data loss.
Account Termination
You may close your account at any time. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.
On termination, your data will be deleted within 30 days.
Changes to Terms
We may update these terms from time to time. We'll notify you by email for material changes. Continued use after the
effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
Contact
Questions about these terms? privacy@markbot.org
